rubrics.justification: The response overstates image quality and describes a fully expanded, well-defined 3AA blastocyst with cohesive TE and prominent ICM, but the image appears more collapsed/poorly visualized with indistinct ICM and limited clearly assessable TE; several features are inferred from the provided grade rather than visible morphology.

It integrates age, BMI, tubal factor, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, prior miscarriage, and ovarian response with embryo quality reasonably well, though AMH is unavailable and some conclusions are somewhat generalized.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, linking embryo quality and favorable patient factors to prognosis, with only minor overconfidence and some unsupported assumptions from morphology.

Most recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, but endorsing PGT-A based mainly on a single prior miscarriage and suggesting ERA after one failed good-quality transfer are more controversial and not strongly guideline-driven; aspirin/heparin mention is appropriately conditional.
Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, and future-cycle considerations, though some suggestions are somewhat generic and not highly individualized.
